description: Automatically opens double doors placed handle-to-handle

mods.name: TwinDoors
mods.description:
TwinDoors makes double doors behave like real double doors.
When two wooden or copper doors are placed side by side with their handles facing each other, opening one will automatically open the other.
Works with all hand-operated wooden and copper doors.
No redstone required. No configuration needed. Just clean, intuitive behavior.

releases.notes:
### Changes
- Fixed door sync only working on same Y level
- Fixed sneaking with item interaction bug

releases.notes:
## TwinDoors v1.0.0

### Features
- Automatically opens paired doors together
- Works with standard Minecraft doors
- Lightweight

### Requirements
- Minecraft 1.21.10
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API

### Installation
1. Download the .jar file below
2. Put it into your `mods` folder
3. Launch the game

### Issues
Report bugs here:
